title: Chuk Chuk Rail Gari | Manipuri Kids Song & Rhymes | BuBu TV - Manipuri
description:
A cheerful Manipuri song about the little train that whistles at the station and teaches kids to wait for their turn.
It shows how everyone stands in a neat line, one by one, and waves goodbye with a smile.
Sing along with the chuk chuk train and learn patience and friendship!
